headline: US Oil Fund Rises 0.83% Amid Persistent Fuel Shortages
summary: The US oil fund rose 0.83% to $158.17 as the Iran conflict keeps fuel supplies tight and US inventories fall.
why: Geopolitical tensions in key oil-producing regions and tightening supplies directly impact petroleum and broader energy market valuations.

impacts.name: US Oil Fund
impacts.why: The input notes a direct 0.83% increase in the US oil fund.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Concerns over supply constraints linked to the Iran conflict and falling US stock levels heightened supply tightness, driving fund prices upward.
